scripts.caseflow:typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @alwaystrack/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @alwaystrack/companion-host && npm run typecheck --workspace @alwaystrack/companion-extension
scripts.smartscript:demo: tsx apps/smartscript-companion/src/cli.ts capture-fixture --fixture apps/smartscript-companion/fixtures/alwayschat-sample.json --today && npm run smartscript:process
scripts.check: npm run check:source && npm run build
scripts.check:source: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.check:docs: node scripts/check-doc-integrity.js && node --test tests/documentation/doc-integrity.test.mjs && node tests/documentation/rollout-audit-check.mjs && npm run docs:api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @alwaystrack/shared && npm run build --workspace @alwaystrack/companion-extension && npm run build --workspace @alwaystrack/smartscript-companion && npm run build --workspace @alwaystrack/web && npm run build --workspace @alwaystrack/api && npm run build --workspace @alwaystrack/companion-host
scripts.test:regression: npm run test --workspace @alwaystrack/api -- sales-documents.service.test.ts wiki.service.test.ts faq.service.test.ts notifications.service.test.ts
scripts.test:jobs:redis: RUN_REDIS_JOBS_TESTS=true JOB_QUEUE_DRIVER=bullmq npm run test --workspace @alwaystrack/api -- queue.redis.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm run check:docs
scripts.coverage:check: npm run coverage --workspace @alwaystrack/shared && npm run coverage --workspace @alwaystrack/companion-extension && npm run coverage --workspace @alwaystrack/smartscript-companion && npm run coverage --workspace @alwaystrack/web && npm run coverage --workspace @alwaystrack/api && npm run coverage --workspace @alwaystrack/companion-host
scripts.security:deps: npm run security:deps:prod && npm run security:deps:all
scripts.security:ci: npm run security:deps && npm run security:licenses && npm run repo:hygiene
scripts.beta:preflight: npm run env:check:beta && npm run test --workspace @alwaystrack/api -- auth.service.test.ts access-policy.test.ts env.test.ts search.service.test.ts operations.service.test.ts sales-documents.service.test.ts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:e2e:beta-permissions && npm run smoke:beta-local
